title: Guardiola-Walker fallout revealed in new Manchester City documentary

intro:
A new documentary series has lifted the lid on tensions inside Manchester City, with BBC Sport reporting that it exposes a bust-up between manager Pep Guardiola and former captain Kyle Walker. The programme focuses on what are described as Guardiola's final two seasons at the club and includes material that highlights a confrontation between the pair.

The disclosure, covered by BBC Sport, adds to growing public interest in behind-the-scenes football documentaries that explore squad dynamics, leadership and the pressures of top-level management.
